note: Files are in evals/fixtures, written by tools/make_po_fixtures.py. Every expected value comes from the scenario (what each invoice truly is) and plain arithmetic in that generator, never from this package. A case with rounds runs them first, in order; what each records is the history of the next. Answers: a key that is a card's code answers every card of that code; unanswered cards take their default, as a skipped card does. Checked on every case, whatever it says: every invoice line is linked, waiting, a cost nobody ordered or on no PO — one of the four; every link below the exact tier was confirmed by a person; every line says whether it was tested three-way or two-way and why, a three-way line names its receipts and a two-way line has none; an invoice that passes has no reason code and one that does not has one; nothing is marked approved or paid; every PO line's billed quantity is the sum of the lines counted on it; the working paper passed its own quality gate; the same input gives the the same figures, the same matches and the same questions (computed.json identical; a workbook's packaging is not compared).
